current_scale_set_execution.authority_transport_problem: human issue-comment body is embedded in JobDisplayName and independently reparsed by workflow/controller/root policy

reconciliation.downstream_transport: typed JSON with exact source/workflow/manifest digests over Unix socket

key_findings.finding: JobDisplayName is authority-bearing wire format across multiple parsers/languages.
key_findings.consequence: valid ingress syntax can be falsely rejected downstream without any authority fact changing

key_findings.finding: root provisioner REJECTED is converted to Go error and returned from scaler into listener.Run
key_findings.consequence: request-local policy denial can terminate the controller and cause systemd restart loops

key_findings.finding: lambda-research-engine-gpu currently contains multiple incompatible root runner envelopes, including 0-GPU, 1-GPU, and 2-GPU execution
key_findings.consequence: a JIT runner tailored to one observed job is not guaranteed to be compatible with any pending job GitHub may assign from the same scale set

key_findings.finding: GitHub documents TotalAssignedJobs as the authoritative scale signal and individual lifecycle message arrays as non-authoritative for counting backlog
key_findings.consequence: route-specific capacity decisions cannot safely be reconstructed from per-message parsing when heterogeneous contracts share one scale set

key_findings.finding: host-attest was added as an option to candidate validation even though host attestation has a different authority/visibility requirement than an isolated candidate runner
key_findings.consequence: control-plane diagnostics should be a maintenance/diagnostic operation, not a qualifier on candidate execution

key_findings.finding: all 23 registered routes currently match their pinned trusted workflow blob on repository main
key_findings.consequence: current incident class is not caused by workflow-pin drift

key_findings.finding: all registry-managed scale-set controller instances run as the same Unix UID ci-controller while root provisioner authorizes that shared SO_PEERCRED identity
key_findings.consequence: root cannot cryptographically/kernel-distinguish which runner-class controller sent a request; a compromised controller can attempt to claim another class unless local peer identity is redesigned

key_findings.finding: controller identity derivation and maintenance targeting hardcode lane in {cpu,gpu}
key_findings.consequence: the installed control model cannot represent heterogeneous execution contracts without reparsing per-job route metadata; runner_class_id must replace lane as the scheduling/capacity identity

key_findings.finding: 22 of 23 registered execution routes use exactly command + candidate SHA; only gpu-experiment-public adds one workflow-local candidate selector that does not alter root launch authority
key_findings.consequence: a generic optional infrastructure qualifier grammar is unnecessary; host-attest was a control-plane classification error, not a missing generic argument feature

target_invariants: human command text is parsed exactly once at ingress and never becomes root-policy wire format
root launch envelope is a function of a typed runner class/contract, not free-form job content
every job eligible for one scale set is safe and executable on every runner that scale set may provision
policy DENY is terminal request data and never a listener-process failure
scheduler lifecycle state, local execution state, and policy result are distinct state machines
executor APIs are generated from a versioned route catalog and cannot synthesize unsupported protocol strings
host diagnostics, project reconciliation, and candidate execution remain separate authority planes

correlation_model.problem: JobAvailable may omit JobID; current controller resolves REST job by dynamic JobDisplayName equality and also parses that name for authority.
target: trusted workflow has exactly one self-hosted job for a registered runner class, or each self-hosted job has a root-catalogued static job name
controller correlates WorkflowRunID + repository + trusted workflow path/ref + expected request labels/static job name to exactly one nonterminal REST job
JobDisplayName may be compared as an opaque expected static identifier only; it is never parsed for command, candidate SHA, route, or resource authority
REST numeric workflow job ID becomes canonical local job identity once resolved
recovery may use the Scale Set Client JobID when present but must reconcile it with the same REST numeric identity

failure_algebra.rule: request-local outcomes are durably recorded/cleaned and Scale returns nil so the listener acks; only controller-fatal failures may stop listener.Run

target_maintenance_plane.invariant: maintenance parses the owner command once, then root consumes typed runner-class operations; maintenance commands never enter the scale-set execution protocol

installs: project manifests and exact workflow pins
target_reconciliation_plane.invariant: reconciliation is policy deployment; it never schedules or executes candidate work
